description: Overlap structure: annual deaths / fatal crashes (FARS, observed) and KA / all crashes (CRSS, estimated) cross-classified by target-segment membership
population: FARS fatal crashes and deaths 2022-2024 (census); CRSS police-reported crashes 2022-2024 (sample)
method: Cells = combinations of segments; FARS alcohol membership is the mean over 10 BAC implicates, so cells are expected counts. CRSS cells: design-based SE (Taylor linearisation, 42 df); value blanked and flagged 'suppressed' if n<30 sampled records, 'unstable' if RSE>30%, 'no_sample_records' if empty (the engine uses every cell, see baseline.json)
